# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Refactor

## Visual Evidence

Add before/after screenshots or a short screen recording for UI changes.

## Testing

- [ ] Opened the site locally
- [ ] Checked desktop layout
- [ ] Checked mobile layout
- [ ] Verified navigation links
- [ ] Verified certificate modal behavior
- [ ] Checked browser console for errors

## Notes

Add anything reviewers should know.
